_comment: UWG demo: a local stdio server on the ISOLATED demo store. Merge into ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json and restart Claude Desktop. The --directory is the demo worktree (branch demo/uwg-ladder). AICESAT_PORT 8792 keeps it off Kevin's 8765 and the test server's 8791; Open in 3D opens that port in the browser.
